title: St. Johns Premier Boat Rentals
specs: Includes paddleboard, floating platform, towable raft, games, Bluetooth stereo, and 40" smart TV
Gloomy Weather Guarantee allows reschedule or partial refund if day interrupted by bad weather
Renter must have valid driver's license and be at least 25 years old
If born after January 1, 1988, must have Florida Boater Education ID Card
Renter and guests must sign liability waiver
Designated driver must show government photo ID and boating safety certificate if required
Children 6 years and under must wear life jackets at all times
Boats accommodate maximum 10 guests regardless of age or weight

variants.label: VIP experience with a captain, call to book

blurb: Guests rent 24ft pontoon boats equipped with a floating platform, paddleboard, towable raft, games, Bluetooth stereo, and a 40" smart TV. Boats accommodate up to 10 guests and include all necessary safety equipment and life jackets. Drivers receive a safety briefing and on-water instruction before departure.
extraNote: $500 damage deposit authorized on credit card, released 24 hours after return if no damage · Cancellation allowed anytime up to booking start time with reschedule or refund · Full refund if operator cancels due to unsafe weather or unforeseen circumstances · Late return fees: $25 after 20 minutes, full daily rate after 1 hour · No drinking and driving; legal limit 0.08 BAC
